properties.displayName: OT/IT - After-Hours Interactive Logon to Critical Asset
properties.description: Interactive or remote-interactive logon (4624 type 2/10) to a critical-asset host outside 06:00-20:00 local. Legitimate emergency maintenance happens — this rule exists so it is SEEN and confirmed, not so it is assumed. Triage: confirm with on-call maintenance schedule before escalating.
properties.query:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 4624 and LogonType in (2, 10)
| join kind=inner (_GetWatchlist("critical-assets") | project Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("hostname",""))) on Computer
| extend LocalHour = hourofday(TimeGenerated)
| where LocalHour < 6 or LocalHour >= 20
| extend TargetAccount = TargetUserName
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetAccount, LogonType, IpAddress
